name: 44304 · Akron, OH
findings: ZIP 44304 (Akron) has 24 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (67% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 44304 (Akron) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 44304 (Akron) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 50% of the typical level).
